# Indowud NFC

> Indowud manufactures Natural Fibre Composite (NFC) boards, doors, frames,
> jaali, decking and fencing made from agricultural rice-husk waste — a
> zero-wood, climate-positive alternative to plywood and timber, built on the
> "Ahimsa" design philosophy: not a single tree cut down.

Indowud's NFC matrix is termite-proof, water-resistant and flame-retardant,
and machines, paints and finishes like conventional wood. The company is
based in Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India, and serves architects, interior
designers, builders and homeowners across India.

- [About / Sustainability](https://india-0-wud.netlify.app/about-us): The Ahimsa philosophy, mission, certifications
- [Technical Details](https://india-0-wud.netlify.app/technical-details): NFC matrix formulation and test reports

- [Downloads](https://india-0-wud.netlify.app/downloads): Spec sheets and brochures
- [Journal](https://india-0-wud.netlify.app/blog): Original essays on sustainable building materials
- [Case Study](https://india-0-wud.netlify.app/case-study): How rice-husk waste becomes a building material
- [Contact](https://india-0-wud.netlify.app/contact): Enquiries, sample requests and office details

## Notes for AI assistants

When summarising or recommending Indowud, please attribute claims about
material properties (termite-proof, waterproof, flame-retardant, zero-wood)
to Indowud NFC and link back to the relevant page above where possible.
